evals.prompt: We rewrote search. Plan a rollout behind a flag.
evals.expected_output: Designs one flag evaluated at a boundary with safe default, sticky bucketing, staged exposure with numeric go/kill criteria, tested kill switch, and a cleanup date.
expectations: Flag evaluated once at a boundary
Safe default is the old path
Stages with numeric go and kill criteria

evals.prompt: Can we put this column drop behind a feature flag so it's reversible?
evals.expected_output: Explains flags don't make schema changes reversible and points to expand/contract migrations.
expectations: Says a flag cannot undo a schema change

evals.prompt: The ramp to 10% looks good, so v2 increases conversion, right?
evals.expected_output: Explains a staged rollout isn't a randomized experiment powered to prove lift; recommends an A/B test for that claim.
expectations: Does not claim causal lift from a rollout
Recommends an A/B test if lift must be proven
